source.title: LIGO-G1600204-v6: P150914 Figure 1
source.authors: LIGO Scientific Collaboration and Virgo Collaboration

time.reference: Figure 1 time origin; 2015-09-14 09:50:45 UTC as labeled in the original publication
time.construction: Each series uses its own original t0: t[i] = t0 + i*dt; arrays need not share t0 or n.

processing.upstream: Published Figure 1: 35–350 Hz band-pass plus band-reject filters for instrumental spectral lines. These are filtered detector strain, not raw strain and not whitened data.
processing.local: Parse published ASCII; retain all samples and individual time origins; round strain values to 8 decimal places in units of 1e-21. No local filtering, resampling, fitting or per-series normalization.
processing.aligned_h1: Use the upstream shifted-and-inverted H1 curve verbatim. The published Figure 1 ASCII curve advances H1 by exactly 7.0 ms and inverts its sign, verified by matching the overlapping original samples. The reported inferred arrival delay is about 6.9 (+0.5/-0.4) ms; distinguish that inference from the rounded display transformation. This projection is specific to this event and detector orientations.
processing.nr: Numerical-relativity waveforms projected onto each detector; parameters consistent with inferred GW150914 ranges. The original release explicitly says the waveform was not tuned to precisely remove the signal.
processing.bands: Template/wavelet low and high arrays are the published 90% credible regions, not raw measurement error bars.
processing.residual: Published detector strain minus filtered NR waveform. Small signal may remain; residuals are not proof of noise-only data.
